avis.texte: I have sensitive combination/ oily skin that is acne prone and tends to be congested and just irritated. This product makes my skin appear so radiant, bouncy, and even. Definitely noticing overall improvements in my skins radiance and completion after consistent use.
Very hydrating, water-like consistency, and minimizes pores like it says. I use it as a buffer twice a day in between my toner and serums
Seriously feel like this has heloed my pores stay small in appearance and clean. Has been an essential step in my skincare routine and have noticed a difference.

Using Himalayan Pink Mineral Salt to deep-clean pores and 9 Peptides to firm skin, while Centella Asiatica soothes, offering a refreshing, non-sticky finish for oily, combination, and acne-prone skin this lightweight, watery skincare serum targets large pores, sebum, and elasticity. I use about 6 to 8 drops after toner and noticed my pores are getting and looking smaller.
The product is very lightweight on my skin and left it feeling soft and moisturized. Very satisfied.

I have loved this serum so far! It has minimized my pores around my nose with every use. I use it on my nighttime routine and when I wake up my pores look good! I recommend it. I received this product as a free sample.

avis.titre: I found my holy grail product for smoother skin
avis.texte: I've been struggling with visible pores for a while, and this serum is a game changer. Not only does it noticeably minimize the appearance of my pores, but it also leaves my skin feeling incredibly soft and hydrated not stripped or dry like other pore products. It has a beautiful, lightweight texture that sinks right in. My makeup goes on so much smoother now. 10/10 recommend if you want that 'filtered' look in real life!

I received a free sample of the Madagascar Centella Poreminimizing Fresh Ampoule in exchange for an honest review. Thank you to the BzzAgent sampling program for the sample! I used this product in tandem with limited products from my existing skin care routine to give it the best chance. I enjoyed the lack of a heavy fragrance, as I am very sensitive to strong smells. The product is on the thinner side, which I can be good depending on what you look for. It dried down nicely and provided a minor plumping effect. After testing this out for a few weeks, I unfortunately can't say I have noticed a big difference in my skin. I hope to see improvement with more time as I do enjoy the product overall, as it is affordable for the size and benefits.

For a few weeks now I've been using it daily. The packaging is gorgeous and sturdy and glass which is a HUGE plus!!! It is a massive bottle and you get so much product making it an AMAZING value. In terms of performance, this leaves my skin feeling so clean, clear, healthy and smooth when I put it on. I love wearing this under my makeup and moisturizer. I notice a huge difference in how much less oily it is throughout the day and my makeup last longer. My pores feel significantly tighter when I use it. I haven't however seen any long term benefits though. My skin looks and feels the same when I don't use it or the morning after when I apply it as part of my night routine. I'm nowhere near finishing the bottle but it's now been a few weeks of using it daily. I'm Hopeful Ill get to see some significant long term benefits.

If you need a glowy look STAT, this ampoule doesn't disappoint! It is extremely refreshing to put on your face and pats in really well. I struggle with sensitive skin and usually just stick to Ordinary's hydration serum but I was pleasantly surprised. I don't think I really noticed any difference with pores but I will continue to use this and hope for the best! It also feels great when you need a little extra love in the skin department. I received this Madagascar Centella Poreminimizing Fresh Ampoule as part of a sampling promotion through Bzz Agent for an honest review.

My combination skin loves the Poremizing Fresh Ampoule! My face/eyes were irritated and uncomfortable due to sensitivity to my sunscreen and I used it after the shower and felt better. My husband noticed that it made my face look fresh and my pores less noticeable. I love that it's fragrance free, vegan, and cruelty free. Korean beauty is next level; I'm familiar with this brand and used the SKIN1004 MADAGASCAR CENTELLA SOOTHING CREAM over top in the second photo. The ampoule's a watery, light texture that feels great, gentle yet effective. I received this product in exchange for my review but honestly I would purchase with my own money because it's impressive, the glass packaging feels luxe, and it's a reasonable price for the amount received. I like that it's not harsh on my skin and calms it down.

I recently received a free sample of the Madagascar Centella Poreminimizing Fresh Ampoule through the BzzAgent sampling program. I used the Poreminimizing Fresh Ampoule for 2 weeks, and unfortunately, didn't see much of a difference in my skin. I could see this product working for someone with older, more wrinkly, or dehydrated skin, as it does a good job of plumping up the skin. But as a young person without many wrinkles and very oily skin, I didn't receive many benefits from using it. I liked that it had very little to no fragrance and didn't irritate my skin, though.
I tried to give the product extra time but I don't see any noticeable changes. It feels fine goes on nicely, no complaints about the product itself just superfluous in my routine

I received this product for free as part of a sampling program, and these are my honest thoughts. I wasn't expecting to like this as much as I do. The texture is super lightweight and sinks in fast with zero stickiness. My skin feels calmer almost immediately, and with consistent use my pores look smoother, especially on my cheeks. It didn't irritate my skin or trigger breakouts, which is huge for me. It layers perfectly with the rest of my routine and works great under makeup. I'd honestly repurchase this and keep it in rotation.

This serum was so soothing to put over irritated skin. avis.titre: Centella Poremizing Fresh Ampoule – First Impressions Review
avis.texte: I'm 37 with combination, mature skin that deals with redness and hormonal acne, so I'm careful about what I introduce into my routine. I started using the Centella Poremizing Fresh Ampoule after receiving it through a promotional offer, and I'm genuinely glad I gave it a try. I've been using it a few times a week, worked into my normal routine on the days I'm not using stronger actives. The texture is lightweight and refreshing, and it absorbs quickly without any tackiness. One of the biggest wins for me is how easily it layers—I've been able to use it alongside my vitamin C and peptide serums with zero pilling or irritation. My skin often flares with redness, but this ampoule feels calming the moment it goes on. Over time, I've noticed my skin looking more balanced and less congested, and the areas where my pores tend to appear larger look smoother and more refined. It hasn't triggered breakouts, which is always a concern for my hormonal acne. Even though it's still relatively new to my lineup, it has become a product I genuinely look forward to using. It leaves my skin feeling calm, fresh, and subtly more polished. I'm excited to see how the benefits continue to build with ongoing use.

I just started using the Madagascar Centella Poreminimizing Fresh Ampoule and I'm seriously impressed. The texture is super lightweight and sinks into the skin instantly—no stickiness at all. I also love that it doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. Instead, it leaves my face feeling fresh, hydrated, and clean without any oily residue. If you're looking for something gentle, I highly recommend!

avis.titre: First pore minimizing product that ever worked for me
avis.texte: I have combination, East Asian skin and live on the east coast where we have four seasons. I have always had issues with pores and acne, and have never had any 'pore minimizing' products work for me, until the Madagascar Centella Poreminimizing Fresh Ampoule. The formula is scentless and feels weightless on my skin. It's so light and watery that I was skeptical, but after a week of use along with my normal routine, I noticed my pores were visibly smaller! It's currently cold, dry, and windy and this stuff doesn't make my skin feel dry or crack. Its so lightweight that I can see myself using it all summer too.

I've been using this product twice a day—morning and night—and I've already noticed a few positive changes within just a few days. I have combination skin, so I'm usually very careful when trying anything new, especially in Korean skincare, but I'm really happy with how this is working for me. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without leaving any sticky or greasy residue. There's no strong fragrance, which I love, and I haven't experienced any irritation—no breakouts, redness, or discomfort at all. My skin feels smooth, fresh, and well-hydrated after every use. On top of that, the packaging is beautiful and feels premium, which just adds to the overall experience. So far, I'm genuinely loving this product and excited to keep using it.

I absolutely love the Madagascar Centella Poreminimizing Fresh Ampoule! After just a few uses, my pores looked noticeably smaller and my skin felt so much smoother. It gives such a fresh, lightweight hydration without ever feeling greasy. My complexion looks clearer, calmer, and more even every single day. I've tried so many pore products before, but nothing has worked this well. My makeup even goes on better now because my texture has improved so much. I'm genuinely impressed with how fast I saw results. Highly, highly recommend this ampoule—it's a new favorite in my routine!
